_readme: Narration and shot list for the demo video. Each sentence is one subtitle cue; 'say' (optional) is what the speech engine reads when the written form would be mispronounced. A shot starts at sentence 'at' of its segment and runs until the next shot. Rectangles are [x, y, width] in the source image's pixels (height follows 16:9); the camera moves from 'from' to 'to'. Sources: assets/<name>-2x.png, made by capture.py. To use your own voice, put voice/<segment id>.wav|mp3|m4a next to this file and run make_video.py again.

sentences.text: One kilogram of R-404A warms the planet like 3.9 tonnes of CO₂, and when it is destroyed, someone is paid in carbon credits.
sentences.say: One kilogram of R 4 0 4 A warms the planet like 3.9 tonnes of C O 2, and when it is destroyed, someone is paid in carbon credits.

sentences.text: This is lot 42: recovered from a small air conditioner, destroyed, and credited once.
Every rule in our ledger accepted it.
And the air conditioner never existed.
This market is simulated; the gap is real.
Their kilograms are recorded in separate systems: customs quotas, technician logs, reclaimer reports and carbon registries.
Each checks its own books.
Nobody checks the same kilogram between them, and that seam pays.
In the EU, reclaimed R-404A sold at 140% of the virgin price in early 2025, and virgin gas has been sold as reclaimed.
sentences.say: In the E U, reclaimed R 4 0 4 A sold at 140 percent of the virgin price in early 2025, and virgin gas has been sold as reclaimed.

sentences.text: We audited 436 destruction and reclamation projects at three carbon registries.
Not one publishes which container, and how many kilograms, a credit draws on.
Kigali Balance enforces one rule.
Every kilogram claimed as reclaimed or destroyed must trace back to a kilogram recovered from a real, registered unit.
Each lot carries a provenance class that can never be swapped.
A recovery needs two signatures: the technician's scale and the unit's owner.
It can never exceed what is booked inside the unit.
A destruction needs an independent verifier.
And each destruction event can be claimed by one registry, once.
Does it hold?
We replayed a three-year simulated market, 7,359 events with twelve kinds of injected fraud, against the real contracts.
Every decision matched a separately written rule mirror.
Fuzzing throws thousands of forged recoveries at it, and none gets through.
Then we set AI red-team agents loose on it.
The first found a real hole: undocumented gas could be laundered into credits.
A second, given only the fixed code, found a way around our fix.
Both are fixed and are now tests that run on every push. A human audit is still to come.
So how was lot 42 caught?
Not by the rules, but by the trail they force.
Faking a recovery needs a second signer, and co-signatures leave a pattern.
Our AI flagged both the company that recovered lot 42 and the take-back point that co-signed for it.
Over three simulated years, it caught every naive fraudster and flagged under one percent of honest companies.
Fraudsters who adapt mostly slip through, but only by staying tiny: 4 kilograms in three years instead of 136.
Kigali Balance claims no credits; it is an enabler.
We don't claim a big number.
Counting only destroyed gas, our model puts the effect in a Japan-sized market at about 0.06 million tonnes of CO₂e a year, and says how a pilot would measure it.
sentences.say: Counting only destroyed gas, our model puts the effect in a Japan-sized market at about zero point zero six million tonnes of C O 2 equivalent a year, and says how a pilot would measure it.

sentences.text: We would start where trust between systems matters most: Türkiye's compliant reclaimers, as COP31 comes to Antalya.
sentences.say: We would start where trust between systems matters most: Türkiye's compliant reclaimers, as COP 31 comes to Antalya.

sentences.text: Every kilogram has to add up.
